messages:
marco: raining all day, staying in and decluttering. need a 'gentle but not sleepy' playlist + one short movie (20-60m) that's oddly comforting. ideas? :cloud_rain:
jenny: try mellow chamber pop -> Sufjan, Iron & Wine, then some early Joanna Newsom. keeps you focused but dreamy. for short films, 'The Lunch Date' (1989) is 12m and weirdly warm.
oz: if you want something longer-ish but light: 'The Trip' (2010) ~ 95m but it's basically 2 friends eating and riffing. perfect for background unpacking.
priya: audiobook rec for rainy afternoons: 'The Secret Lives of Church Ladies' short stories 15-30m each if you listen to a chapter. also music: ambient piano playlists are great.
marco: nice — does anyone have a 'no-lyrics' playlist? my partner naps if lyrics show up :sweat_smile:
jenny: instrumental picks: Olafur Arnalds, Nils Frahm, and that 'lofi hip hop radio' vibe (but curated 1-hour mixes so it doesn't dip in energy).
oz: snack-bot: drop 'no-lyrics' playlist link? :eyes:
snack-bot: Playlist suggestion: "Rain+Unpack (No Lyrics)" - 1h12m. Includes Nils Frahm, Max Richter, Julia Kent. Link: https://music.internal/playlists/rain-unpack-nolyrics
priya: short movie rec: 'My Dinner with Andre' is 111m so too long, ignore me. for 45m: watch the anthology episode "St. Elsewhere" black comedy bits? ok brain fried. alternatively: 'Safety Not Guaranteed' is 86m and cozy indie.
marco: loving the no-lyrics list. gonna pair it with chamomile + toast. thanks y'all. leaving a box of cinnamon rolls for whoever drops by later :bagel:
jenny: cinnamon rolls = best incentive :raised_hands: enjoy!
oz: post pix of the final shelf setup pls :camera_with_flash:
marco: will do — after I finish one final playlist swap. peace out :v:
